batch: second held-out batch: COCO image<->text and image<->image gaps from independently trained encoders; multilingual sentiment transfer

predictions.P1: independently trained image->text gaps have a LOW linear ceiling: CCA(val lambda) test P@1 < 0.5 on every such gap (1000 candidates)
predictions.P2: in image->text gaps, hubs SURVIVE whitening: N1 hub skew after CCA > 2 on a majority of gaps
predictions.P3: independently trained image->image gaps behave like text gaps: CCA(val lambda) P@1 > 0.8 and hub skew after centring < 1.5 on a majority
predictions.P4: selection rule (ID>=0.5 -> identity else CCA val-lambda) mean regret <= 0.01 over the batch (candidates identity/rotation/centred rotation/CCA/MLP)
predictions.P5: sentiment transfer: retrieval P@1 does not rank maps for transfer (Spearman between map P@1 and mean transfer accuracy < 0.5 across maps), and the best label-free map is a centred rotation or truncated CCA, not the InfoNCE MLP
